note: PAE READOUT UNFROZEN, pair_transition FROZEN, lambda 0.005, alpha_rank 7.854, alpha_pae 1.0, 15 epochs. THE QUESTION: is the PAE pathway the limit? oe6sru ran this exact objective with the readout FROZEN and DID NOT LEARN THE PAE LOSS AT ALL -- held-out PAE 2.9085 -> 2.9029 over seven epochs, a 0.2% change, while bouncing more than that between epochs (2.9863 at epoch 2); training PAE 2.29-2.56 with no trend, rising at epochs 3, 5 and 7. Both terms were stuck, not only the ranking one. The structural suspect is that pae_ln and linear_no_bias_pae were frozen, fixing the map from z_pair to PAE logits so the only route to the PAE loss was through z -- the same narrow pathway every ranking arm in this project has failed to move. WHAT CHANGES against oe6sru: pairformer_stack.blocks.3.pair_transition is REMOVED from --train-only (-786,944 parameters) and pae_ln.weight+bias (+512) and linear_no_bias_pae.weight 64x256 (+16,384) are ADDED, giving 15 tensors / 60,928 parameters against oe6sru's 17 / 830,976. L2-SP COVERS THE READOUT BUT NOT THE LAYERNORM: --l2-sp-exclude 'frame_dir,pae_ln' leaves pae_ln trainable and out of the anchor while linear_no_bias_pae stays anchored, so 9 tensors / 57,344 parameters are priced against shipped. The readout is a pretrained 64x256 matrix and distance from shipped is a prior worth holding for it; a LayerNorm's 512 scale-and-bias numbers set the scale that readout sees, and anchoring them would fight the adjustment this arm exists to allow. frame_dir stays excluded because it is zero-init and anchoring it to its own init is plain decay toward zero. ALL THREE WEIGHTS MEASURED AT THIS TRAINABLE SET by probe_readout.sh, none defaulted: unfreezing a 16,384-parameter readout changes both |g_PAE| and |g_rank|, so neither oe6sru's alpha_rank 5.347 nor its lambda 5e-04 carries over. CONTROLS: oe6sru (same objective, readout frozen, pair_transition trainable) and 24u342 (same pool, cross-seed ranking only, no PAE, 50 epochs). NOTE ntwjfp and qiodxz trained pae_ln and linear_no_bias_pae before, but with the pre-flag LINEAR within-seed loss, no tau, no L2-SP and no orientation input, so neither is a control for this. CRITERION: selected DockQ and fraction above 0.23 over the 18 val10 interfaces against shipped DockQ 0.2909 / frac 0.5556 / oracle 0.5968, from this run's own shards; held-out PAE from val_loss.csv is the secondary diagnostic this arm was built to move. TEN-EPOCH MINIMUM. FALSIFIER: held-out PAE still flat, which would move the suspicion off the frozen readout and onto the objective or the data, every pathway into the PAE head having then been opened.
